facilities.serving_utility: Berkeley Electric Cooperative (power from Santee Cooper)
facilities.note: COARSE-REGION CAVEAT, IMPORTANT. Served by Berkeley Electric Cooperative, a member of Central Electric, which buys from Santee Cooper. The SC balancing authority reads 0.056 carbon-free in 2025, which is genuinely coal- and gas-heavy -- BUT Santee Cooper's jointly-owned V.C. Summer nuclear reports under the SCEG balancing authority (0.421), not under SC. So the SC footprint understates the carbon-free content of power actually available to this site. Never present 0.056 without this caveat.
Detector rank 7. OPPD is a ZONE of SWPP, not a BA. Meta buys wind via a dedicated OPPD rate (Rattlesnake Creek); the grid it physically draws from is still SPP.

Detector rank 3. APS named as Microsoft's partner for the Goodyear/El Mirage campuses. CAUTION: AZPS generation-side figures are under investigation for a reporting artefact; demand-side rank is sound.

Detector rank 6. Dominion Virginia Power provides retail service to AWS's Northern Virginia data centers. NOVEC also serves parts of the region; sites outside Dominion territory are NOT covered by this row.

Separate row on purpose: NOVEC is a different serving utility from Dominion in the same metro and is building substation capacity outside Dominion's territory for AWS. Same BA/zone footprint, different retail provider.

notes: Sites are mapped from the serving utility outward, never inferred from the state.
utility_parent and utility_ticker describe the SERVING UTILITY's owner, not the datacenter operator.

4 of 7 sites are served by public power districts or member-owned cooperatives with no listed equity. Cheap hydro and wind sit disproportionately with public power, so a material share of this buildout lands where there is no stock to trade.
Coverage is partial and hand-curated. Absence of a site is not evidence it does not exist.
